artworks.title: On the Moosic, East, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of a landscape with a sloping hill, sparsetrees, and a small settlement below. The horizon is low, showing a distant tree line fading into the sky. In the foreground, there are wooden tracks or supports with scattered logs and chopped wood. The settlement consists of wooden buildings arranged neatly on flat terrain, with a few houses in the distance. The color palette is predominantly sepia-toned, giving the image a muted, aged appearance.

artworks.title: Pecks Crossing and Plane, E., Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky terrain in the foreground leading to a small settlement with white and light-colored buildings scattered in open fields. A road runs through the center of the settlement disappearing in the distance. A dense forest marks the horizon. The sky is overcast with a muted, sepia tone.

artworks.title: Providence, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a rural landscape captured from an elevated perspective. In the foreground, there is a grassy area with a mix of short and tall vegetation. Further back, there is a cluster of small buildings and houses within a densely treed area. The horizon includes rolling hills and mountains, with a large structure visible on the right. The color palette is sepia, giving a vintage feel. The sky occupies a significant portion of the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: Breaker at Dickson, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial setting, possibly a mining or processing operation, from a slightly elevated perspective. The view includes silhouetted trees against a pale sky, a wooden industrial building with rising smoke, rocky terrain with railway tracks, wooden structures, and debris. In the distance, there is a large wooden building, elevated tracks, and additional buildings stretching away. The photograph has a sepia-toned palette with shades of brown, gray, and soft black.

artworks.title: The Pockets, Honesdale, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large industrial structure on a sloped terrain. The structure is made of wood with vertical beams supporting it. There are smaller buildings in the distance on higher ground to the left, and barren hilltops with sparse trees on the right. The sky appears hazy or overexposed. The color palette is sepia tones.

artworks.title: On the Moosic, West, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden structure on a sloped terrain with figures walking on it. The horizon is high in the image with distant hills in the background. The sky above the horizon is overexposed. Wooded areas and buildings are visible beyond the structure. The image is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage look.

artworks.title: Von Storch Breaker, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tree stumps in the foreground and a town in the distance, nestled at the base of hills. The town consists of several buildings partially obscured by trees. A large tree and the hills provide a natural backdrop. The color palette is muted, with shades of sepia and soft grays, giving the image a historical atmosphere. The style is typical of early photography, focusing on capturing landscape and built environment details.

artworks.title: Carbondale, Section 1, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of a densely packed townscape. There are various wooden buildings, some two stories high, appearing industrial or residential. A rail line on an elevated wooden structure curves through the scene, suggesting transportation infrastructure. The horizon features a gently rolling hillside with scattered houses and roads. In the background, wisps of smoke rise from chimneys, indicating activity. A line of trees marks the edge of the town against the sky. The photograph is in sepia tone, highlighting the textures and details of the wooden architecture and landscape.

artworks.title: Honesdale, Section 3, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated point of view overlooking a town in a hilly landscape. The horizon is high in the frame, with barren hills and some trees and scrub. The town has uniform rectangular buildings on the slopes with various rooftops and structures. The buildings are light in color with some angled toward the light source, creating contrast. The overall color tone is sepia, with shades of brown and beige. The landscape forms geometric patterns with rooftops, streets, and terraces, against the backdrop of gently rising hills.

artworks.title: Honesdale, Section 4, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a small town with closely packed houses, leading towards a rocky hill in the distance. The hill is covered with trees and shrubs at the top. The town's homes form a varied pattern of rooftops. The clear and detailed photograph is monochromatic with sepia and grayscale tones, resembling a historical image. Low lying hills and sparse forestry extend beyond the town, accentuating its location at the foot of the rocky hill.

artworks.title: Honesdale, Section 1, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a small town in a valley, viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is marked by hills with trees, and the town has various buildings with different rooflines. A railway track is visible in the foreground. The color scheme is warm with sepia tones, giving the image a vintage look.

artworks.title: Waymart, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with figures in a field with tree stumps and rocks. In the background, there is a hill, clouds, and a village with houses and a church steeple. The image appears to be in sepia tones, with a limited color palette of earthy browns and greys.

artworks.title: Racket Brook Breaker, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial landscape from an elevated viewpoint. Trees and a hill are visible on the horizon. The sky appears overcast with clouds. Vegetation and wooden debris are scattered in the foreground, with a dirt path leading to an industrial structure with a tall chimney emitting smoke. A railroad or logging structure is attached to the industrial building. The color palette is monochrome sepia.

artworks.title: Honesdale, Section 2, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a town located at the base of a hillside. The horizon features the sloping hilltop, with sparse trees and a rocky outcrop. The town is composed of various buildings with pitched roofs, including structures with steeples, potentially churches. The color scheme is sepia, giving a historical feel. The buildings are mainly wooden, with fencing visible. The terrain becomes steeper and less populated as it extends away from the town.

artworks.title: Lake View, near Waymart, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view from a slightly elevated point, overlooking a grassy area. Close to us is a grassy field with sparse trees, small branches, and logs. In the middle ground, there is a body of water reflecting light, bordered by tree clusters. The horizon shows a distant ridge of land with sparse trees and cleared fields beyond the water. The color palette is subdued, giving a warm, nostalgic feel. The sky above is mostly clear.

artworks.title: The Musical Contest Between Apollo and Pan
artworks.medium: etching and sulfur tint printed in blue on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober, in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: It is a drawing of mythical figures gathered in a wooded landscape. The scene depicts various figures interacting among themselves. The figures are satyrs and other mythological beings with human and animalistic features. They are surrounded by trees with mountains in the background. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses and expressive gestures, suggesting a lively moment. Monochrome shading is used to add depth and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: Statue of Constantine
artworks.artist: Francesco Faraone Aquila after Gian Lorenzo Bernini
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length statue of a man on horseback set within an ornate archway. The man is seated on a rearing horse with his head up, appearing to look into the distance. He has curly hair and a beard, wearing classical drapery. The horse is also in a dynamic pose, with its front legs raised and a stylized mane. The background features rich textures and a decorative arch with geometric and floral patterns. An inscription below identifies the figure as the equestrian statue of Constantine the Great at the Vatican.

artworks.title: Stone Wall, Rear of Fredericksburg, with Rebel Dead
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a battlefield trench lined with objects. The image captures a scene along a dirt trench, bordered by a stone wall on one side, and marked by scattered items like rifles, hats, and pieces of cloth. The stone wall extends into the distance alongside a path that fades into the horizon amid barren trees. The photograph is taken in a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Parte dell'antica via Appia (Section of the Old Appian Way)
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Jean-Baptiste Le Prince
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from a low vantage point. The composition shows an extensive scene with the horizon high up, where the sky meets ancient ruins on the right. The ruins, marked by columns and arches, are scattered across the terrain stretching into the distance. In the foreground, two figures lean over a broken column amidst fallen masonry and stone structures. The etching features detailed brushstrokes conveying the density of trees and rough surfaces of the ruins. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes the fine details and antiquarian ambiance. Shadows and depth are depicted through tonal variations, adding to the light filtering through the landscape.

artworks.title: Plants and Ivies by a Stream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas and Margaret Morgan Grasselli, in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image depicts a lush woodland environment with intricate and delicate brushstrokes that meticulously detail leaves and plants, creating a sense of depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of grey to emphasize the linework in the flora. Faint outlines of tree trunks are visible in the distance, adding a sense of mystery as they fade into the background.

artworks.title: Le chêne au ravin (Oak Tree by a Ravine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas and Margaret Morgan Grasselli, in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third with a row of trees and a light sky. To the right, a farmer with oxen is visible on a ridge, leading the eye towards the horizon. Closest to us are detailed foliage and a large tree with intricate branches in the central area. The depiction shows intricate brushstrokes or engraving capturing the texture of leaves and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and soft black, emphasizing the texture and depth of the landscape.

artworks.title: William Blake
artworks.artist: Luigi Schiavonetti, after Thomas Phillips, R.A.
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man who is seated, facing slightly to the viewer's left. His head is turned to the side, with a thoughtful expression on his face. His facial features are detailed, with prominent cheekbones, a firm jaw, and eyes that appear deep in focus. The man has short, receding white hair with subtle waves. He is dressed in a formal dark jacket over what appears to be a waistcoat and a high-collared shirt. He is holding a pencil in one hand, poised over a surface. The background is a plain, textured surface that frames the subject without distraction. Loose lines fill the background. The engraving is signed with the name William Blake at the bottom.

artworks.title: Cattle Fording a Stream
artworks.artist: attributed to Robert Robinson,after Nicolaes Pietersz Berchem
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with an elevated point of view showcasing rolling hills and mountains merging with the sky. The artist used intricate brushstrokes to create texture and detail, giving a realistic quality to the natural elements. The monochromatic color palette creates contrast between light and dark areas. In the foreground, a person on horseback leans over the water, while a shepherd tends to cattle and goats. To the right, a large tree and vegetation add depth. In the distance, rocky outcrops and mountains suggest a rugged terrain.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1726: Hercules and the Hydra
artworks.artist: Francesco Faraone Aquila, after Alessandro Specchi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with mythological elements. The composition features a symmetrical structure with vaulted archways on either side, framing a central rocky formation. The rocky formation rises prominently at the center, with figures perched upon it. The lower part of the central formation includes a cave-like opening where a horse-like creature is visible. The architectural elements are detailed and ornate, with columns, balustrades, and decorative urns adorning the top. The style suggests a classic or baroque influence.
